description: The plot illustrates an ablation study on the HateXplain dataset, comparing the performance of different model configurations across three evaluation metrics. The x-axis displays categorical model variants, ordered from left to right as "Full model (Ours)", "w/o Prompt", "w/o Augmentation", "w/o Attention", and "w/o Prompt & Augmentation". The y-axis is labeled "Metric (%)" and features a linear scale ranging from 58 to 66 with tick marks at intervals of 2. Three metrics are plotted as solid lines with circular markers. The "Precision" metric, represented by a purple line, starts at 65.45 for the "Full model (Ours)", drops to a low of 61.06 at "w/o Prompt", and then steadily increases to 62.22 at "w/o Augmentation", 64.06 at "w/o Attention", and ends at 65.44 for "w/o Prompt & Augmentation". The "Recall" metric, shown as a blue line, begins at its peak of 65.78 for the "Full model (Ours)", decreases to 59.64 at "w/o Prompt", rises to 63.75 at "w/o Augmentation", and then declines to 59.17 at "w/o Attention" before ending at its lowest point of 56.82 for "w/o Prompt & Augmentation". Finally, the "F1-score" metric, depicted by a brown line, starts at a high of 65.56 for the "Full model (Ours)", falls to 60.16 at "w/o Prompt", increases to 62.63 at "w/o Augmentation", and then decreases to 59.67 at "w/o Attention", concluding at 57.74 for "w/o Prompt & Augmentation".
